meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 当用户要求把技术话题讲得通俗时，Claude会用简单英语按“五个W”拆解，产出分点说明。
howto.when: 当用户要求对某个技术内容做通俗英语解释，并涵盖“五个W”时触发。

say.text: 用大白话拆解一下区块链：谁在用、什么是它、在哪用、为什么、何时出现。
say.note: Claude会按五个W给出通俗英语解释。

say.text: 这个API文档太技术，请按五个W给我讲一遍。
say.note: 将得到分点式的简单英文说明。

say.text: 我想搞懂量子计算，请用大白话拆解它的五个W。
say.note: 将按五个W输出通俗英文解释。

howto.what_en: When asked to explain a technical topic in plain terms, Claude will produce a simple-English breakdown structured around the five Ws.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical, covering the five Ws.

say_en.text: Break down blockchain in plain English: who, what, where, why, and when.
say_en.note: Claude will cover the five Ws in simple English.

say_en.text: This API doc is too technical. Explain its five Ws in simple English.
say_en.note: You'll get a bullet-style plain-English walkthrough.

say_en.text: I want to understand quantum computing. Break down its five Ws for me.
say_en.note: This will trigger the plain-English explanation.
